comparison.objective: Install a spring cage fastener through a square rack opening, versus preassembling a collet inside a clamping nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneously compress two retaining legs, pass hooks through a plate and release them; candidate aligns an extraction groove at a marked eccentric lip, then tilts and rolls to snap in.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both hooks to cross and retain, fixture stability and gripper release; candidate requires circumferential retention and a light withdrawal check. Candidate lacks numeric force/deflection thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both involve snap retention, but the tested abilities—two-leg compression-through-panel versus eccentric groove capture and rolling engagement—are materially different.
